title: 12 Fall Outfit Ideas for Men, Built From Earth Tones
description: Twelve fall outfit ideas in camel, navy, forest and cream, plus five basics from Amazon listings to build them, each under $40, with one honest limit per pick.
dek: Camel, navy, forest and cream. Twelve looks to browse, five basics to build them.
hook: A fall wardrobe runs on a few repeat pieces: a knit, a chino or jean, a boot and a jacket. Browse the twelve looks first, then pick the basics that fit the ones you like.
We did not test these. We read each listing and use only what it says, so check the size chart and details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is made of or how it is sized.
Brand-name designer pieces, since this guide is about fall basics at everyday prices.
Anything sold only in one color or size range with no size chart on the listing.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and how it is cut or sized.
The listing gives a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: If you only buy one, make it the chino. It works with every knit in the gallery. Add the cable knit next, then the boots and belt.

picks.name: Amazon Essentials Men's Long-Sleeve Cotton Cable Knit Crewneck Sweater
picks.alt: Illustration of a folded navy cable knit sweater
picks.best_for: A classic knit under a jacket or on its own
picks.limit: Cotton only, so it is not a heavy winter knit
picks.why: A long-sleeve cable knit crewneck in 100% cotton. Big and tall sizes are listed.
picks.con: Cotton knits are lighter than wool, so plan a coat for cold days.

picks.name: Amazon Essentials Men's Slim-Fit Casual Stretch Chino
picks.best_for: Pants that dress up or down with any knit
picks.limit: Slim cut, check waist and inseam
picks.why: A slim-fit casual chino with stretch, sold in many colors. It pairs with most looks above.
picks.con: The cut is slim, so check the waist and inseam options if you prefer a looser fit.

picks.name: Chaoren Men's Leather Belt, 1 3/8 Inch
picks.alt: Illustration of a coiled brown leather belt
picks.best_for: Finishing a chino or jean outfit
picks.limit: Size by measuring a belt you own
picks.why: A leather belt about 1 3/8 inches wide, sold for business and casual wear.
picks.con: Belt sizing is easy to get wrong, so measure a belt you already own first.

picks.name: JOUSEN Men's Chelsea Boots, Slip-On with Memory Foam
picks.alt: Illustration of a pair of brown Chelsea boots
picks.best_for: A slip-on boot for jeans or chinos
picks.limit: Check sizing notes and upper material
picks.why: A slip-on Chelsea boot with memory foam, per the listing title.
picks.con: Read the sizing notes and the upper material on the listing before you order.

picks.name: Amazon Essentials Men's Quarter-Zip Mock Neck Sweater
picks.alt: Illustration of a folded gray quarter-zip sweater
picks.best_for: A neat layer without a collared shirt
picks.limit: Check colors and sizes on the listing
picks.why: A French rib mock neck sweater with a quarter zip. It suits the quarter-zip look in the gallery.
picks.con: Colors and sizes vary, so check the listing for the one you want.
